programme.title: John Patitucci, Marco Pignataro, Joe Lovano & Terri Lyne Carrington
programme.sub-title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg's Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation's message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Art Tatum, Bud Powell, Thelonious Monk & Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Charlie Haden
programme.sub-title: Charlie Haden & Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1985, American jazz bassist and composer Charlie Haden performed a mesmerizing concert at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Known for his collaborations with free-jazz pioneer Ornette Coleman, Haden brought his own New Liberation Orchestra to the festival.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: La Velle
programme.sub-title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.” This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust
programme.sub-title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer's well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach's technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue
programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- "Can t Get You Out Of My Head", "Spinning Around"- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed "Aphrodite" album including "All The Lovers" and "Get Outta My Way".

programme.desc: Jess and Max are ready to call off their wedding due to the overwhelming stress over how out-of-control the planning and everything has become. At their wit's end, they go to see Billie, a beautiful ‘always a bridesmaid' kind-hearted soul who has a non-profit devoted to donating the components of already-paid-for, yet dismantled weddings, to the underserved and people with special needs. However, Max's brother Charlie will stop at nothing to keep Jess and Max together and enlists the help of Billie by enticing her with extra help for her business.

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: NYC ad exec Holly Maddux dreams of the perfect life, the perfect job, and of course, the perfect man to sweep her off her feet. When she wakes up one day to find the perfect man awaiting her, who is nothing more than a mannequin come to life, she must decide if perfect is the perfect fit for her.

programme.desc: When a successful woman returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he's really a prince in disguise, longing to find the true spirit of the holidays! It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

Brothers Joe & Ben Weider were the architects of muscle. Along the way they discovered Arnold Schwarzenegger, inspired female empowerment, championed diversity and started a worldwide movement.

As the Mongol hordes begin ransacking Russia, the invaders pillage and burn down cities, until Kolovrat leads several hundred brave souls to avenge his love, his people and his homeland. A breath-taking tale of courage and self-sacrifice for one's country.

When their drug abusing mother is released from prison, Rey kidnaps his younger brother Oliver and escapes their desert home for the California coast, determined to rebuild their family. A moving story of love and forgiveness co-starring Johanna Braddy (Easy A). A must watch!

Barry Pepper (The Green Mile) takes the lead in this masterclass of action-suspense.

programme.title: John Patitucci, Marco Pignataro, Joe Lovano & Terri Lyne Carrington
programme.sub-title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg's Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation's message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Art Tatum, Bud Powell, Thelonious Monk & Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Charlie Haden
programme.sub-title: Charlie Haden & Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1985, American jazz bassist and composer Charlie Haden performed a mesmerizing concert at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Known for his collaborations with free-jazz pioneer Ornette Coleman, Haden brought his own New Liberation Orchestra to the festival.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: La Velle
programme.sub-title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.” This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust
programme.sub-title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer's well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach's technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Enrique Iglesias
programme.desc: Filmed at Odyssey Arena, Belfast, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Enrique Iglesias featuring unforgettable version of his hits: "Bailamos", "Hero", "Be With You" and many more…

programme.title: Kylie Minogue
programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- "Can t Get You Out Of My Head", "Spinning Around"- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed "Aphrodite" album including "All The Lovers" and "Get Outta My Way".

Armada con una fotografía de su amado, Giovanna viaja incansablemente por Rusia para encontrarle cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Qiu Ju, una mujer china

programme.title: Varda por Agnès
programme.desc: Una película documental única e impredecible de una narradora fascinante. Agnès Varda arroja luz sobre su experiencia como directora y aporta una visión personal de lo que ella llamaba “escritura de cine”. Pasión y sabiduría en toda una lección de vida. Una excelente carta de presentación para los recién llegados y un maravilloso regalo de despedida para los cinéfilos que ya conocen su obra.

programme.title: La madre del mal

programme.title: 3 generaciones

Mientras tanto, tres generaciones de la familia afrontan sus dudas, miedos y prejuicios hasta aprender a aceptarse mutuamente.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta

programme.title: Dumplin'
programme.desc: "Dumplin" comienza a trabajar en una cadena de comida rápida, donde conoce a un chico que le gusta. La atracción entre ambos es mutua, aunque Dumplin comienza a tener dudas sobre su atractivo físico. Decidida a remediar este problema, Dumplin se inscribe en un concurso de belleza.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Tripp Kennedy entra tranquilamente en una sucursal bancaria poco antes de la hora de cierre, justo en el momento en que dos bandas distintas convergen por casualidad con intención de realizar un atraco. Todos ellos quedan atrapados en el edificio durante una noche que promete acción y diversión...

programme.title: Locos De Remate
programme.desc: Richard Pryor y Gene Wilder protagonizan en una desopilante comedia sobre dos convictos que intentan por todos los medios de escapar de la cárcel.

programme.title: ¿Cuándo Llegamos?
programme.desc: Nick , un joven operador está deseando conseguir pedirle una cita a una mujer atractiva, Suzanne, de la que está locamente enamorado. Después de esperar un largo tiempo parece que el momento más esperado para Nick está a punto de llegar. Suzanne se encuentra atrapada en Vancouver y necesita a alguien que pueda recoger a sus hijos y llevarles hasta ella, Nick se ofrece para ser esa persona sin dudarlo, pero lo que no sabe es que para ellos ningún hombre es lo suficientemente bueno para su madre. El viaje que Nick se imaginaba no tendrá nada que ver con el que les espera, ya que acabará siendo una pesadilla.

programme.title: Desmadre De Madres
programme.desc: Lo único que Allyson y sus amigas quieren es una cena pacífica con una charla de adultos...una largamente esperada noche de madres a solas.

programme.title: Papa Canguro 2
programme.desc: Charlie Hinton (Cuba Gooding Jr.) y Phil Ryerson (Paul Rae) asumen la dirección de un campamento de verano. Su desconocimiento de los grandes espacios abiertos, unas instalaciones destrozadas y un variopinto grupo de campistas hacen que muy pronto la situación se les vaya de las manos. Frente a las amenazas de cierre y el descenso de inscripciones, Charlie llama a su padre, de quien está distanciado, para que le ayude a organizar el campamento y a enseñar a todo el mundo a trabajar en equipo con perseverancia y flexibilidad.

programme.title: Mariachis
programme.desc: Dos combos rivales se enfrentan en un festival, pero la competencia da un giro inesperado cuando un artista es asesinado. Con varios músicos y participantes bajo sospecha, la celebración se transforma en un misterio donde todos podrían tener algo que ocultar.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (tal para cual)
programme.desc: La trama muestra como Trinidad descubre que Bambino ha sido injustamente condenado a muerte por el asesinato de dos pistoleros. Logrará sustituir al verdugo y salvarle de la muerte, huyendo con él en busca de los verdaderos autores del delito.

programme.title: Las campanas de San Angelo
programme.desc: Gridley contrabandea plata desde México usando un pasaje secreto. El guardia Roy Rogers lo descubre y envía a Lee Madison por ayuda, pero ella es capturada. Con refuerzos y la ayuda de Trigger, Roy intenta rescatarla y frenar el plan de Gridley.

programme.title: Cinco pistolas
programme.desc: Shalee Jethro (Dorothy Malone) ayuda a su padre a dirigir una estación de diligencias en el desierto.

programme.title: Union Bound
programme.desc: El sargento Joseph Hoover lucha por la Unión, pero tras ser capturado y enviado a un campo de prisioneros, comprende el verdadero significado del cautiverio. Con la ayuda de un amigo y unos esclavos, logra escapar y emprende un arriesgado camino hacia la libertad.

programme.title: Locas y Atrapadas
programme.desc: Cinco mujeres quedan atrapadas en un ascensor y comparten historias de sus vidas.

programme.title: Colours: Los Rostros sin Nombre
programme.desc: Laura, una artista de un pueblo remoto cuyo padre se niega a dejarla pintar y los límites de la pobreza son los obstáculos a los que se enfrenta. Esto no le impide triunfar con su obra "Los Rostros sin Nombre", que nunca firma porque, como dice, siente en su corazón que ninguno de sus cuadros está terminado.

programme.title: La Cuestión de Dios
programme.desc: Un superordenador del MIT con inteligencia sobrehumana es alimentado con todo el conocimiento humano para responder la pregunta definitiva: ¿existe Dios? Cuando empieza a censurar Internet, el gobierno lo apaga. Pero un exprogramador lo activa en secreto, desatando una carrera contrarreloj entre ciencia, fe y poder.

programme.title: Mi Multimillonario Secreto
programme.desc: La hilaridad sobreviene cuando un apuesto hombre de negocios va de incógnito por Nueva York como un "multimillonario sin techo".

programme.title: Testigo virtual
programme.desc: Thomas asiste en directo desde su web al asesinato de Cathy. Al querer llamar a la policía se dá cuenta de que no tiene ni su nombre ni su dirección a pesar de llevar varios meses chateando con ella. Thomas se ve implicado en la investigación que realiza Claire, una joven especialista de la delincuencia informática. Las indagaciones les conducen hasta el hermano de Thomas que al parecer tiene relación con una organización criminal que actúa en directo por Internet. Pero a Claire le retiran el asunto de la noche a la mañana. Entonces, ella y Thomas deciden colocar una trampa con la que esperan revelar toda la verdad.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela Louis De Bernieres basada en un hecho real, narra como un perro kelpie australiano se une a una comunidad minera durante los años setenta.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: Momo: Una aventura contrarreloj
programme.desc: Momo es una niña tímida y cariñosa que ha encontrado nuevos amigos y una casa en medio de las ruinas de un antiguo anfiteatro. Pero un día, repentinamente, los Hombres Grises irrumpen en la ciudad, con el objetivo de robar el tiempo a la gente. Momo desearía impedírselo, pero no sabe como… Casiopea, una pequeña tortuga mágica, la lleva a conocer al Maestro Hora, el Administrador del tiempo. Él es la única persona que puede ayudarla. Cuando regresa para luchar contra los Hombres Grises, se da cuenta de que ya no hay nadie con quien hablar o jugar y teme haber perdido para siempre a sus amigos. El mundo ha cambiado y todos han sido englobados en una nueva y rígida estructura social… A pesar de su repentina soledad, está decidida a intentar lo imposible para salvar a sus amigos y a la ciudad entera.

programme.title: Mi amigo Blue
programme.desc: Una icónica historia de amistad entre un muchacho y un perro único y desgarbado que se convertiría en una leyenda australiana.

programme.title: ¡Ni te me acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo.

programme.title: Cuando todo esté en orden
programme.desc: Una película honesta y sentida sobre las relaciones entre padres e hijos y la devastación que suponen las drogas.

programme.title: La Hermandad
programme.desc: En un apartado monasterio vive una hermandad de monjes benedictinos. Se ocupan de curar a Sara, una famosa escritora de novelas de terror y misterio, tras un grave accidente. Muy pronto Sara empieza a observar ciertos detalles que llaman su atención.

programme.title: El pomo azul
programme.desc: Soledad, que forma una pareja aparentemente consolidada con Juan, busca el piso más apropiado para su futuro en común.

programme.title: Seven Dorms of Death
programme.desc: Seven Dorms of Death tells the tale of a cursed stage play that is about to be performed at a New England college. Unfortunately for the director, the young cast, and anyone else unlucky enough to be involved with the production, someone has deadly plans for the play! Can a pair of homicide detectives and a student with psychic powers solve the mystery before it's too late'

programme.title: Spider Baby
programme.desc: An inbred family is visited in their rural mansion by greedy distant relatives intent on taking the family home and inheritance.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: After investigating inside a neighbors attic, two high school friends, known for making prank videos, are increasingly plagued by a series of disturbing, supernatural events involving a creepy, vintage doll named Heidi - but no one will take their claims seriously, until it is too late.

programme.title: La odisea de los pioneros
programme.desc: Año 1755. Las colonias inglesas están siendo devastadas por las atrocidades de la guerra. Poderes europeos opuestos entre sí han estallado sobre el valle de Ohio, destruyendo el hogar de familias. Cuando dos hermanas son secuestradas por nativos, luchan por mantener su fe bajo las circunstancias más difíciles.

programme.title: Thor: god of thunder (esp)
programme.desc: Loki, el malvado tío de Thor, ha escapado de Asgard en busca de Yggdrasil, el Árbol de los Nueve Reinos, un árbol que contiene el poder del universo y que está oculto en la Tierra.

A principios del siglo XX, China se encuentra en crisis. El país está dividido en facciones enfrentadas, los ciudadanos pasan hambre y las recientes reformas políticas han empeorado la situación. La dinastía Qing, gobernada por un emperador de siete años y su despiadada madre, la emperatriz viuda Longyu, está completamente desconectada tras 250 años de poder incuestionable. Huang Xing acaba de regresar de Japón, donde estudió el arte de la guerra moderna. Al ver a su país desmoronarse, siente que no tiene otra opción que tomar las armas.

programme.title: If Looks Could Kill
programme.desc: Faith está orgullosa de ser por fin policía en su ciudad natal de Stillwater, Oklahoma. Se une a Paul, su antiguo amor, en el cuerpo de policía y se preocupa cuando él se involucra sentimentalmente con Jessica, una belleza errática con un pasado criminal. Entonces, cuando Jessica tiene una aventura con un joven impresionable, Faith debe construir un caso contra Jessica antes de que Jessica destruya la vida de Paul.

programme.title: Me case con un desconocido
programme.desc: Emma y David acaban de casarse. Durante su luna de miel, la joven es atacada salvajemente. Su extraño comportamiento y su negativa a cooperar hacen que David se convierta rápidamente en el principal sospechoso. Emma rechaza esta sugerencia, pero empieza a tener dudas: ¿conoce realmente al hombre con el que se ha casado?

programme.title: Indomable
programme.desc: Estilizado y contundente thriller de acción de Steven Soderbergh. La hermosa Mallory Kane es una joven soldado contratada por numerosos gobiernos para realizar tareas que ellos mismos no podrían llevar a cabo... Se le encomienda una misión donde es traicionada. Ahora sólo planea su venganza.

programme.title: Juntos para vencer
programme.desc: Un adolescente acosado que sueña con ser el compañero de Chuck Norris se entrena en artes marciales para hacer realidad sus sueños.

programme.title: Resistencia
programme.desc: Verano de 1941. Los ejércitos de Hitler avanzan por Europa. Para millones de personas, eso supone una muerte segura, pero para los hermanos Bielski, tres jóvenes granjeros judíos de clase trabajadora, se convierte en algo más.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: ¿Es posible viajar en el tiempo para evitar una catástrofe? El capitán Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) tiene la difícil misión de conseguirlo en esta eficaz película de acción y ciencia-ficción considerada como una de las mejores películas del género de los últimos años.

programme.title: Ultimate Justice
programme.desc: Cuando un familiar es atacado, un equipo de antiguos soldados de élite es llamado de nuevo a la acción.

programme.title: One Million K(l)icks
programme.desc: Un luchador con un corazón de oro se ve arrastrado a un torneo de artes marciales clandestino.

programme.title: Gun Fight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un sheriff en un enfrentamiento con una sanguinaria banda de forajidos.

programme.title: El almirante: Mar de fuego
programme.desc: En 1597, Yi Sun-Shin lidera 12 barcos contra más de 300 navíos japoneses en una batalla histórica.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Una nave espacial que viaja a un planeta-colonia lejano y transporta a miles de personas, tiene una avería en una de sus cámaras de sueño. Como resultado, un único pasajero se despierta 90 años antes de tiempo. Ante la perspectiva de envejecer y morir solo, finalmente decide despertar a un segundo pasajero.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: ¡Vuelven Los Cazafantasmas! Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis y Sigourney Weaver. Son los auténticos cazadores de seres sobrenaturales, los únicos que pueden salvar al mundo de la fantasmagórica plaga que se extiende por todo el planeta. Ya han llegado a New York. La estatua de la libertad está en peligro.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. El Pistolero Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), último miembro de una orden de caballería denominada los Pistoleros, inicia la búsqueda de un edificio mitológico conocido como La Torre Oscura. Según cuenta la leyenda, esta torre es el centro de convergencia de todos los universos.
